mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has moved from -38.4 to -33.4 over the last four weeks, a modest but consistent improvement. This momentum in foot-traffic recovery, absent new shocks, is expected to persist and push RETAIL_REC mildly higher over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days averages lower than the last 28 days despite the prior four-week upward trend, the momentum hypothesis is rejected.
